description: Land Title Settlement Department - Magama Thissamaharama D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830086 (23/0968)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and owner particulars. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
